card.name: Devakkoothu
card.era: Traditional (as old as the Chirakkal dynasty; revived 1985-86)
card.tagline: The only Theyyam performed by a woman
card.profile: Devakkoothu (also Devakoothu) is a ritual theyyam performed in Kerala at the Thekkumbad Koolom Thayakav temple near Cherukunnu in Kannur district - notable as the only theyyam performed by a woman (Wikipedia). The goddess embodied is Valliyamma, named for having become lost in a forest of creepers (valli); the performance narrates this myth, with Narada as a second character (Wikipedia). Only non-menstruating women may perform the role of Valliyamma, after a 41-day vrata, and the rite is held once every two years on the fifth day of the Malayalam month of Dhanu (December) (Wikipedia).
card.insight: Believed to be as old as the Chirakkal dynasty, Devakkoothu lay dormant for many years and was revived in 1985-86; before 2012 it was performed for fourteen years by Lakshmi Amma, wife of Matai Kelu Panikar (Wikipedia).
